description: The TN-47 RTO is the primary transport office for the Karur district in Tamil Nadu, located near the Collectorate in Thanthonimalai. It handles a high volume of commercial vehicle registrations due to Karur's prominence as a hub for bus bodybuilding and textile exports. The office manages driver licensing, vehicle fitness certifications, and tax collection for the local jurisdiction.
address: Regional Transport Office, Thanthonimalai Road, Near Collectorate Office, Karur, Tamil Nadu
